sfida-fine-mondo.domanda: What is the name of the bigger exercise that closes every world?

feedback.missione-finale: Missions are the exercises after the lessons: there are many in every level, not just at the end.
feedback.esame: There are no graded exams in the course: the final exercise has a video-game name.
feedback.livello-bonus: There are no bonus levels: every level is part of the main path.

suggerimenti: Re-read the “How it is organized” section of the Welcome aboard lesson.
Think of video games: at the end of each world there is an opponent tougher than the others.
The answer is “Boss Challenge”: a bigger exercise that brings together everything you learned in the world.
sfida-fine-mondo.spiegazione: Every world ends with a Boss Challenge: a bigger exercise that uses everything you learned in that world and tells you whether you are ready for the next one.

struttura-corso.domanda: Put these parts of the course in order, from biggest to smallest.
suggerimenti: One of these parts contains the other two.
Every world contains a few levels.
The right order is: World, Level, Lesson. A world contains levels, and each level contains lessons and missions.
struttura-corso.spiegazione: The course is divided into worlds; each world contains levels; each level contains lessons (and missions).

quando-riparti-da-zero.domanda: In which of these cases do you end up starting from zero? Choose all the right answers.

opzioni.cancelli-dati: You clear the browser's browsing data.
opzioni.altro-browser: You open the course from another browser or another device.
opzioni.chiudi-scheda: You close the course tab and reopen it tomorrow.
opzioni.navigazione-privata: You study in private browsing and then close the window.
opzioni.usi-suggerimento: You use a hint in a mission.

feedback.chiudi-scheda: Closing and reopening the tab deletes nothing: local storage stays in the browser.
feedback.usi-suggerimento: A hint only reduces the XP of that mission, it doesn't delete your progress.

suggerimenti: Your progress lives in the local storage of a specific browser, on a specific device.
Ask yourself: in which cases is that space emptied, or not the same space as before?
There are three right answers: clearing browsing data, using another browser or device, and closing a private browsing window.
quando-riparti-da-zero.spiegazione: Your progress lives in that browser's local storage: it disappears if you empty it (by clearing data or closing private browsing) and it isn't there on another browser or device. That is why “export” and “import” exist.

costo-suggerimento.domanda: Complete the sentence with a number.
costo-suggerimento.modello: Each hint you use reduces the mission's XP by ___ %.
feedbackSpazi: Write only the number, without the % sign.
suggerimenti: The answer is in the lesson “Points, ranks and where your progress goes”, in the section about hints.
Using all three hints loses three quarters of the mission's XP.
The answer is 25: each hint takes away a quarter of the mission's XP.
costo-suggerimento.spiegazione: Each hint takes away 25% of the mission's XP, but a part is always guaranteed: asking for help is allowed.

quota-codespaces.titolo: True or false: the free quota
quota-codespaces.domanda: If you haven't added a payment method, when you use up the free monthly Codespaces quota you get charged.

feedback.vero: Without a payment method GitHub cannot charge anything: re-read the “How much it costs” section.

suggerimenti: Re-read the “How much it costs” section of the Getting ready for the labs lesson.
What happens to Codespaces when the quota runs out and there is no payment method?
It's false: without a payment method Codespaces stops until the next month, with no charges.
quota-codespaces.spiegazione: False: without a payment method on file, when the free quota runs out Codespaces stops until the next month. There are no surprise charges.

sito-account.domanda: Complete the sentence with the name of the website.
sito-account.modello: To use Codespaces in the labs I need to create an account on ___ .
feedbackSpazi: It's the website where people who develop software keep and share their projects.
suggerimenti: Codespaces is a service offered by a website well known to people who write software.
The full name of the service is “… Codespaces”.
The answer is GitHub (github.com works too).
sito-account.spiegazione: Codespaces is a GitHub service: with a free GitHub account you will get a computer in the cloud ready for the labs.
